name: 의미 밀도
description: 측정합니다 information density uniformity 에 걸친 content.
useCase: 균일한 정보 밀도를 통한 AI 텍스트 감지
mechanism: Segments content into columns and 측정 엔트로피 in each. AI text distributes information too evenly, while 인간 글쓰기 has natural density variations.
source: Dugan et al. (2023) - Real or Fake Text? Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries
parameters: 윈도우 크기: 적응형, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: 엔트로피, CV, 상관관계
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI 생성 text
- Language-agnostic 통계적 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 오탐
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies 에 걸친 문체s
